text:
Ava (sales): Heads up — GreenWave wants a Dedicated commit for Q4: they're asking for 50 A100-equivalent GPUs (Oct–Dec), pinned to us-west1. They expect heavy traffic during product launch in Nov. Can we size and propose buffer?

Jon (eng-infra): Quick calc: 50 GPUs * 24h * 30d = 36,000 GPU-hours/month raw. What's target utilization? If we assume 70% avg util => 25,200 GPU-hours/month. Need peak headroom.

Priya (eng-sre): 70% average seems realistic. For launch week we should plan for 2.5x baseline peak concurrency for 72 hours. Suggest buffer pool instead of static buffer so other customers unaffected.

Jon (eng-infra): Proposed config: baseline 50 GPUs reserved, plus a 12 GPU burst pool (~24%). Burst triggers: sustained queue latency >200ms or token backlog >1M. Fallback route to hosted in us-east1 if buffer exhausted.

Luca (customer-success): GreenWave will only sign if we guarantee <200ms p50 and 99.5% uptime on dedicated. They asked for a 20% buffer in contract. Can we justify 24%?

Wei (finance): 24% buffer raises monthly committed cost by ~24%. If committed price is $X per GPU-hour we need to show ROI. Can we offer tiered buffer (20% standard, 24% for +discount)?

Ava (sales): They prefer fixed commit + a smaller burst billable on usage. Maybe contract: 50 reserved + 20% included buffer, additional burst billed at committed rates but with a cap.

Priya (eng-sre): Operational notes: Pin to us-west1-primary with failover to us-east1. Networking: ensure cross-region KV-cache warm-up; cold start could add ~150ms per request for first minute. Add warm pool pre-warming around launch hours.

capacity-bot: Capacity estimate report generated — see /capacity/reports/greenwave-q4-1753416789 (internal link) :chart_with_upwards_trend:

Jon (eng-infra): Quick snippet for buffer calc I shared earlier:
```
# baseline GPUs = 50
monthly_raw_hours = 50 * 24 * 30  # 36000
assumed_util = 0.7
effective_hours = int(monthly_raw_hours * assumed_util)  # 25200
buffer_gpus = int(ceil(50 * 0.24))  # 12
```

Luca (customer-success): I'll ask GreenWave if they accept 20% included + billed burst cap. Also confirm region preference (they prefer us-west for latency).

Wei (finance): If they agree to 20% included and 10% paid-burst with cap, bottom line looks better. Draft concession: 20% free buffer, up to additional 10% billed at 50% discount.

Ava (sales): Sounds good. Action items: Jon/Priya — confirm autoscaler triggers + failover playbook. Wei — draft pricing concession. Luca — confirm with customer by EOD tomorrow. I'll own the contract language.
